blocks.text: BINI marked another historic milestone as they became the first Filipino act nominated for Favorite Global Music Star at the 2026 Nickelodeon Kids’ Choice Awards. Nickelodeon announced the nominees on Thursday, Oct. 8, with voting now open through the Kids’ Choice Awards website. Fans can cast their votes for BINI at kca.nick.tv/favorite-global-music-star. BINI will compete against Taylor Swift, Zara Larsson, Tyla, Olivia Dean and Tame Impala, who represent their respective regions in the category.
